ex.en: Many famous alumni returned for the school's 100th anniversary.
ex.zh: 許多知名校友回來參加學校百年校慶。

ex.en: The alumni association raises money for scholarships.
ex.zh: 校友會為獎學金募款。

alumni.en: people who have finished studying at a particular school or university

ex.en: Data compression algorithms can be classified in two categories: those with data loss and those without data loss.
ex.zh: 資料壓縮演算法可以分為兩類：有失真的和無失真的。

ex.en: Social media algorithms decide what we see.
ex.zh: 社群媒體的演算法決定我們看到什麼。

algorithm.en: a set of steps used to solve a problem or do a task on a computer

ex.en: Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc.
ex.zh: 黃銅是銅和鋅的合金。

ex.en: The bike frame is made of a light alloy.
ex.zh: 這台腳踏車的車架是用輕合金做的。

alloy.en: a metal made by mixing two or more metals

ex.en: Bill and his younger brother are nothing alike.
ex.zh: 比爾和他弟弟一點都不像。

ex.en: These twin brothers are as alike as two peas in a pod.
ex.zh: 這對雙胞胎兄弟長得一模一樣。

ex.en: Not even our fingers look alike.
ex.zh: 我們連手指都長得不像。

alike.zh: 同樣地；（A and B alike）A 和 B 都

ex.en: It is, even now, a book loved by men and women alike.
ex.zh: 即使到現在，這本書仍深受男女讀者喜愛。

ex.en: The new policy affects managers and staff alike.
ex.zh: 新政策對主管和員工都有影響。

alike.en: in the same way, or used to include both things mentioned

ex.en: We meet on alternate Mondays.
ex.zh: 我們每隔一週的星期一開會。

ex.en: She works alternate weekends.
ex.zh: 她隔週週末上班。

alternate.en: happening every second time or one after the other

ex.en: Please list alternate dates.
ex.zh: 請列出其他可選的日期。

ex.en: We need an alternate route because of the road work.
ex.zh: 因為道路施工，我們需要另一條路線。

alternate.en: that can be used in place of another

ex.en: Tom and I alternate driving on long trips.
ex.zh: 長途旅行時湯姆和我輪流開車。

ex.en: The weather alternated between rain and sunshine.
ex.zh: 天氣時雨時晴。

alternate.en: to take turns, or to happen one after another

ex.en: The tsunami alert was cancelled.
ex.zh: 海嘯警報解除了。

ex.en: The meteorological bureau has issued a red rainstorm alert.
ex.zh: 氣象局發布了豪雨紅色警報。

alert.en: a warning about danger or a message that tells you something

alert.zh: on (the) alert：保持警戒、提高警覺

ex.en: A tsunami is coming, so please be on the alert.
ex.zh: 海嘯要來了，請提高警覺。

ex.en: Staff were told to be on alert for suspicious emails.
ex.zh: 員工被提醒要留意可疑的電子郵件。

ex.en: You're very alert.
ex.zh: 你真機警。

ex.en: Drivers must stay alert on long trips.
ex.zh: 長途開車時駕駛必須保持警覺。

alert.en: quick to notice things and ready to act

ex.en: I'll alert Tom.
ex.zh: 我會通知湯姆。

ex.en: The app alerts you when your package arrives.
ex.zh: 包裹送達時，這個 App 會通知你。

alert.en: to warn someone about a danger or tell them something

alternatively.zh: 或者、要不然（提出另一個選擇）

ex.en: You can pay by card. Alternatively, you can pay in cash.
ex.zh: 你可以刷卡，或者也可以付現金。

ex.en: Alternatively, we could hold the meeting online.
ex.zh: 要不然我們也可以線上開會。

alternatively.en: used to give another choice or idea

alliance.zh: 聯盟、結盟；（企業間的）策略聯盟

ex.en: The two airlines formed an alliance last year.
ex.zh: 這兩家航空公司去年結成了聯盟。

ex.en: Our company entered a strategic alliance with a local partner.
ex.zh: 我們公司和一家在地夥伴建立了策略聯盟。

alliance.en: an agreement between groups or countries to work together

ex.en: Alpha, beta and gamma are Greek letters.
ex.zh: Alpha、beta 和 gamma 都是希臘字母。

ex.en: Alpha is the first letter of the Greek alphabet.
ex.zh: Alpha 是希臘字母的第一個字母。

alpha.en: the first letter of the Greek alphabet

alpha.zh: （軟體）alpha 版、初期內部測試版

ex.en: The alpha version is only for internal testing.
ex.zh: alpha 版只供內部測試使用。

ex.en: We'll start alpha testing next month.
ex.zh: 我們下個月開始進行 alpha 測試。

alpha.en: an early version of a program that is tested inside a company

ex.en: Our goals should align with the company's strategy.
ex.zh: 我們的目標應該和公司策略一致。

ex.en: We need to align our plans with the budget.
ex.zh: 我們必須讓計畫配合預算。

align.en: to arrange or change things so that they agree with each other

ex.en: Please align the text to the left.
ex.zh: 請把文字靠左對齊。

ex.en: Make sure the pictures are aligned.
ex.zh: 請確認這些照片有對齊。

align.en: to put things in a straight line

ex.en: The manager allegedly took money from the company.
ex.zh: 據稱那位經理侵吞了公司的錢。

ex.en: The package was allegedly lost in the mail.
ex.zh: 據說包裹在郵寄途中遺失了。

allegedly.en: used to say that people claim something but it is not proved

ex.en: The aluminum castings must be brushed again.
ex.zh: 這些鋁鑄件必須再刷一遍。

ex.en: These cans are made of aluminum.
ex.zh: 這些罐子是鋁做的。

aluminum.en: a light silver metal used to make cans, planes and tools

ex.en: Visiting all the tourist sights really wore me out.
ex.zh: 逛遍所有觀光景點真的把我累壞了。

ex.en: All employees must attend the meeting.
ex.zh: 所有員工都必須出席會議。

all.en: every one of a group, or the whole of something

all.zh: 全部、大家；唯一的（All you need is…）

ex.en: All you have to do is follow his advice.
ex.zh: 你只要照他的建議做就好。

ex.en: We shall all miss you when you go away.
ex.zh: 你走了以後，我們都會想你的。

all.en: everyone or everything, or the only thing

ex.en: I was all alone in the office.
ex.zh: 辦公室裡只剩我一個人。

ex.en: Your shirt is all wet.
ex.zh: 你的襯衫全濕了。

ex.en: Don't be too hard on him; he's new, after all.
ex.zh: 別對他太嚴格，畢竟他是新人。

ex.en: The meeting was canceled after all.
ex.zh: 會議最後還是取消了。

all.en: used to remind someone of an important fact, or to say in the end

ex.en: I also hope for sunny weather at the weekend.
ex.zh: 我也希望週末是晴天。

ex.en: It is true that television also has some disadvantages.
ex.zh: 電視確實也有一些缺點。

ex.en: Spring Festival is also known as Chinese New Year.
ex.zh: 春節也稱為農曆新年。

also.zh: not only... but also：不但…而且

ex.en: The weather was not only cold, but also wet.
ex.zh: 天氣不但冷，而且很潮濕。

ex.en: Not only does she speak English, but also German.
ex.zh: 她不只會說英文，也會說德文。

also.en: used to show that two things are both true

ex.en: We should always act in obedience to the law.
ex.zh: 我們應該一直遵守法律。

ex.en: You are always digging at me about my clothes.
ex.zh: 你老是挑剔我的穿著。

ex.en: She always arrives early.
ex.zh: 她總是很早到。

always.en: at all times, or every time

ex.en: The rich are not always happier than the poor.
ex.zh: 有錢人不一定比窮人快樂。

ex.en: The customer is not always right.
ex.zh: 顧客不一定永遠是對的。

ex.en: It's already eleven o'clock. I must be leaving now.
ex.zh: 已經十一點了，我得走了。

ex.en: The dance had already started when I got there.
ex.zh: 我到的時候，舞會已經開始了。

ex.en: It seemed that she had already received the money.
ex.zh: 她似乎已經收到錢了。

already.en: before now or before the expected time

ex.en: Nowadays, almost every home has one or two televisions.
ex.zh: 現在幾乎每戶人家都有一兩台電視。

ex.en: The old man was almost hit by a car.
ex.zh: 那位老人差點被車撞到。

ex.en: Oh, I almost forgot! Today is garbage disposal day!
ex.zh: 啊！我差點忘了，今天要倒垃圾！

ex.en: My father allowed me to go to the concert.
ex.zh: 我父親准我去聽演唱會。

ex.en: This company allows its workers to work from home.
ex.zh: 這家公司允許員工在家工作。

ex.en: You are allowed to use the hotel's swimming pool.
ex.zh: 你可以使用飯店的游泳池。

ex.en: The reimagined user interface allows smoother play across devices.
ex.zh: 重新設計的使用者介面讓玩家在各種裝置上玩得更順暢。

ex.en: This app allows you to track your orders.
ex.zh: 這個 App 讓你可以追蹤訂單。

allow.en: to make it possible for something to happen

ex.en: Walking along the street, I met an old friend.
ex.zh: 我沿著街道走時，遇見了一位老朋友。

ex.en: We walked along the river.
ex.zh: 我們沿著河邊散步。

along.en: moving or lying next to the length of something

ex.en: The humble man is getting along with his neighbors.
ex.zh: 那個謙虛的男人和鄰居相處得很好。

ex.en: How are you getting along with your new classmates?
ex.zh: 你和新同學相處得怎麼樣？

ex.en: I found it difficult to get along with him.
ex.zh: 我覺得很難和他相處。

along.en: to have a friendly relationship with someone

ex.en: I can't go along with you on that point.
ex.zh: 這一點我無法同意你。

ex.en: I'll go along with your plan.
ex.zh: 我同意你的計畫。

along.en: to agree with an idea or a plan

ex.en: Can I bring my friend along?
ex.zh: 我可以帶朋友一起去嗎？

ex.en: Why don't you come along?
ex.zh: 你何不一起來？

along.en: with you or with someone else as a companion

ex.en: I don't believe the child came to Tokyo alone.
ex.zh: 我不相信那個孩子是獨自來東京的。

ex.en: We thought it dangerous for her to go alone.
ex.zh: 我們覺得她一個人去很危險。

ex.en: I was scared to be alone in the dark.
ex.zh: 我很怕一個人待在黑暗中。

ex.en: I don't like being alone at home.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡一個人在家。

ex.en: I don't have a bicycle, let alone a car.
ex.zh: 我連腳踏車都沒有，更不用說汽車了。

ex.en: Boston is too cold for me, let alone Chicago.
ex.zh: 波士頓對我來說已經太冷了，更別說芝加哥。

alone.en: used to say that something is even less likely than what was just said

ex.en: They had no alternative but to retreat.
ex.zh: 他們別無選擇，只能撤退。

ex.en: Is there an alternative to driving to work?
ex.zh: 除了開車上班，還有其他選擇嗎？

ex.en: We need to find an alternative supplier.
ex.zh: 我們需要找另一家供應商。

alternative.en: something you can choose instead of another thing

ex.en: Please suggest an alternative date for the meeting.
ex.zh: 請建議另一個開會日期。

ex.en: Solar power is an alternative energy source.
ex.zh: 太陽能是一種替代能源。

alternative.en: different from the usual one and possible to use instead

ex.en: I owe it you that I am still alive.
ex.zh: 多虧了你，我才能活下來。

ex.en: I don't know whether he is dead or alive.
ex.zh: 我不知道他是死是活。

ex.en: Elephants are the largest land animals alive today.
ex.zh: 大象是現今存活的最大陸地動物。

ex.en: For some reason I feel more alive at night.
ex.zh: 不知道為什麼，我晚上比較有精神。

ex.en: The city comes alive at night.
ex.zh: 這座城市一到晚上就熱鬧起來。

ex.en: The image was digitally altered.
ex.zh: 這張圖片經過數位修改。

ex.en: Meanwhile, conditions have drastically altered.
ex.zh: 在此期間，情況已大幅改變。

ex.en: We had to alter our plans because of the weather.
ex.zh: 因為天氣，我們只好改變計畫。

ex.en: Can you alter these pants for me?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我修改這條褲子嗎？

ex.en: I had my suit altered for the wedding.
ex.zh: 我為了婚禮把西裝拿去修改。

alter.en: to change the size or shape of clothes so they fit better

ex.en: I could smell the alcohol on his breath.
ex.zh: 我聞得到他嘴裡的酒味。

ex.en: Europeans are the world's largest consumers of alcohol.
ex.zh: 歐洲人是全世界最大的酒精消費族群。

ex.en: What kind of alcohol do you like to drink?
ex.zh: 你喜歡喝哪種酒？

alcohol.en: drinks such as beer and wine, or the substance in them that makes people drunk

ex.en: Sometimes the Allies could not avoid battle.
ex.zh: 有時候盟軍無法避免戰鬥。

ex.en: She has been my strongest ally at work.
ex.zh: 她一直是我在職場上最堅定的盟友。

ex.en: We need allies to support this proposal.
ex.zh: 我們需要盟友來支持這個提案。

ally.en: a country or person that helps and supports another

ex.en: Germany was allied with Italy in World War II.
ex.zh: 二戰期間，德國與義大利結盟。

ex.en: Germany was once allied with Italy.
ex.zh: 德國曾經與義大利結盟。

ally.en: to join with another country or group to help each other

ex.en: I overslept because my alarm didn't go off.
ex.zh: 我睡過頭了，因為鬧鐘沒響。

ex.en: The alarm clock is set for 5 a.m.
ex.zh: 鬧鐘設在早上五點。

ex.en: The fire alarm went off during the meeting.
ex.zh: 開會時火災警報響了。

alarm.en: a device that makes a loud sound to wake you or warn of danger

ex.en: I am alarmed by your irresponsible attitude.
ex.zh: 你不負責任的態度讓我很擔憂。

ex.en: There's no reason to be alarmed.
ex.zh: 沒有必要驚慌。

alarm.en: to make someone feel worried or afraid

ex.en: The report alleges that the company hid its losses.
ex.zh: 報導指稱這家公司隱瞞了虧損。

ex.en: He is alleged to have stolen the money.
ex.zh: 他被指控偷了那筆錢。

ex.en: The customer alleged that the product was defective.
ex.zh: 那位顧客聲稱產品有瑕疵。

allege.en: to say that something is true without proof

ex.en: That is not altogether false.
ex.zh: 那並不全是錯的。

ex.en: He doesn't altogether trust me.
ex.zh: 他並不完全信任我。

ex.en: The company stopped making the product altogether.
ex.zh: 公司完全停產了這項產品。

ex.en: There were 50 people at the meeting altogether.
ex.zh: 會議總共有 50 人出席。

ex.en: That comes to 300 dollars altogether.
ex.zh: 總共是 300 元。

ex.en: Native Chinese people are working alongside foreigners to change the culture of Shanghai.
ex.zh: 本地人與外國人一起努力，改變上海的文化。

ex.en: I've worked alongside him for five years.
ex.zh: 我跟他共事了五年。

ex.en: The new system will run alongside the old one.
ex.zh: 新系統會和舊系統同時運作。

alongside.en: next to something, or together with someone

alright.zh: 沒事的、沒問題的；可以的

ex.en: Sami is going to be alright.
ex.zh: 薩米會沒事的。

ex.en: Is it alright if I do this kind of thing?
ex.zh: 我做這種事可以嗎？

ex.en: Alright, let's settle on that one!
ex.zh: 好，就決定是那個了！

ex.en: Then, we will go clothes shopping after five o'clock, alright?
ex.zh: 那我們五點以後去買衣服，好嗎？

alright.en: used to show you agree or to start a new subject

ex.en: Many pupils are poor at algebra.
ex.zh: 很多學生代數都不好。

ex.en: Algebra is my favorite subject.
ex.zh: 代數是我最喜歡的科目。

algebra.en: a part of mathematics that uses letters to stand for numbers

ex.en: Do you think there are aliens?
ex.zh: 你覺得有外星人嗎？

ex.en: Let's pretend we are aliens.
ex.zh: 我們假裝自己是外星人吧。

alien.zh: 陌生的、格格不入的；外國的

ex.en: The idea was completely alien to me.
ex.zh: 這個想法對我來說完全陌生。

ex.en: Living alone felt alien at first.
ex.zh: 一開始獨居讓我覺得很不習慣。

alien.en: strange and not familiar, or from another country

ex.en: A resident alien can work legally in the country.
ex.zh: 外籍居民可以在該國合法工作。

ex.en: Every alien must carry a valid residence permit.
ex.zh: 每位外籍人士都必須攜帶有效的居留證。

alien.en: a person who lives in a country but is not a citizen of it

ex.en: The plane flew at an altitude of 3,000 meters.
ex.zh: 飛機在三千公尺的高度飛行。

ex.en: Some people get sick at high altitudes.
ex.zh: 有些人在高海拔地區會不舒服。

ex.en: We are now cruising at an altitude of 10,000 meters.
ex.zh: 我們目前在一萬公尺的高度巡航。

altitude.en: the height of something above the sea

ex.en: Peanuts are a common food allergen.
ex.zh: 花生是常見的食物過敏原。

ex.en: The menu lists all allergens in each dish.
ex.zh: 菜單列出了每道菜的過敏原。

allergen.en: a substance that makes some people sick when they touch or eat it

ex.en: Do you have any allergies?
ex.zh: 你對什麼東西過敏嗎？

ex.en: I have an allergy to milk.
ex.zh: 我對牛奶過敏。

ex.en: Peanut allergy is the most common of food allergies.
ex.zh: 花生過敏是最常見的食物過敏。

allergy.en: a medical condition in which the body reacts badly to a certain substance

ex.en: My aunt gave me an album.
ex.zh: 我阿姨送我一張專輯。

ex.en: Her new album will be released next month.
ex.zh: 她的新專輯下個月發行。

album.en: a collection of songs sold together on a disc or online

ex.en: Will you show me your photo album?
ex.zh: 你能讓我看看你的相簿嗎？

ex.en: Please show me your stamp album.
ex.zh: 請讓我看看你的集郵冊。

album.en: a book for keeping photographs or stamps

ex.en: How many letters are there in the alphabet?
ex.zh: 英文字母中有幾個字母?

ex.en: The English alphabet has 26 letters.
ex.zh: 英文有二十六個字母。

ex.en: I remember my mother teaching me the alphabet.
ex.zh: 我記得我母親教我認字。

alphabet.en: the set of letters used to write a language

ex.en: The knight swore an oath of allegiance to the king.
ex.zh: 騎士宣誓效忠於國王。

ex.en: I pledge allegiance to the flag.
ex.zh: 我向國旗宣誓效忠。

allegiance.en: loyalty to a person, group or country

alarming.zh: 令人憂心的、令人驚慌的

ex.en: The number of cases is rising at an alarming rate.
ex.zh: 病例數正以令人憂心的速度增加。

ex.en: It is alarming how quickly the ice is melting.
ex.zh: 冰融化的速度之快，令人擔憂。

ex.en: Many of our pioneers are still alive... but, alas, many of them aren't alive any more.
ex.zh: 我們的先驅者中許多還活著...但是，唉，其中有許多已經死了。

ex.en: I wanted to go to the concert, but, alas, the tickets were sold out.
ex.zh: 我想去聽演唱會，但是唉，票賣完了。

alas.en: used to show sadness or regret

ex.en: His coolness has alienated his friends.
ex.zh: 他冷酷的性格使朋友們一個一個地疏遠了他。

ex.en: He felt alienated from society.
ex.zh: 他覺得被社會遺棄了。

ex.en: How long have you been alienated from your family?
ex.zh: 你離開家有多久了?

alienate.en: to make people feel unfriendly toward you

ex.en: Many immigrants feel a sense of alienation in their new country.
ex.zh: 許多移民在新的國家會感到疏離。

ex.en: Spending too much time online can lead to alienation from family.
ex.zh: 花太多時間上網可能會讓人跟家人疏遠。

alienation.en: the feeling of not belonging to a group or place

ex.en: He denied all the allegations against him.
ex.zh: 他否認所有對他的指控。

ex.en: The police are investigating the allegations.
ex.zh: 警方正在調查這些指控。

allegation.en: a claim that someone did something wrong, made without proof

ex.en: My dad gives me an allowance of $10 a week.
ex.zh: 我爸每週給我 10 元零用錢。

ex.en: My dad gives me a weekly allowance that I use to buy comics and ice cream.
ex.zh: 我爸每週給我零用錢，我拿來買漫畫和冰淇淋。

allowance.en: money given regularly to a child to spend

ex.en: The duty-free allowance for alcohol is one liter.
ex.zh: 酒類的免稅額度是一公升。

ex.en: Check the baggage allowance before you pack.
ex.zh: 打包前先確認行李限額。

allowance.en: the amount of something that you are permitted to have

ex.en: Employees receive a travel allowance for business trips.
ex.zh: 員工出差可以領差旅津貼。

ex.en: The company pays a monthly housing allowance.
ex.zh: 公司每月發放住房津貼。

allowance.en: extra money paid for a particular cost

allocation.en: the act of giving out money or resources, or the amount given

ex.en: We need to allocate more resources to this project.

allocate.en: to give out money or resources for a special purpose

ex.zh: 那家餐廳在市場後面一條窄巷裡。

ex.zh: 我們家後面的小溪旁長著一棵榿木。

ex.en: The furniture maker chose alder because the wood is soft and easy to carve.
ex.zh: 這位家具師傅選了榿木，因為這種木材質地柔軟、容易雕刻。

ex.en: The story is an allegorical tale about greed and honesty.
ex.zh: 這個故事是一則關於貪婪與誠實的寓言。

ex.en: Critics read the painting as an allegorical image of time passing.
ex.zh: 評論家把這幅畫解讀為象徵時間流逝的寓意畫。

ex.en: Her grandfather was diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease.
ex.zh: 她的祖父被診斷出患有阿茲海默症。

ex.en: Scientists are searching for new treatments for Alzheimer's.
ex.zh: 科學家正在尋找阿茲海默症的新療法。

ex.en: He felt alienated from his classmates after moving to a new school.
ex.zh: 轉學之後，他覺得自己和同學之間很疏離。

ex.en: Many alienated young people spend most of their time online.
ex.zh: 許多感到疏離的年輕人大部分時間都泡在網路上。

ex.en: The alderman spoke at the town meeting about the new park.
ex.zh: 市議員在鎮民大會上談到新公園的事。

ex.en: Residents asked their alderman to fix the broken street light.
ex.zh: 居民請他們的市議員修理壞掉的路燈。

ex.en: Medieval alchemy tried to turn lead into gold.
ex.zh: 中世紀的煉金術試圖把鉛變成黃金。

ex.en: Alchemy was an early form of chemistry.
ex.zh: 煉金術是化學的早期形式。

alchemy.zh: 神奇的力量；神秘的轉變

ex.en: The chef's alchemy turned simple ingredients into a feast.
ex.zh: 主廚的神奇本領把簡單的食材變成了盛宴。

ex.en: There is a kind of alchemy in the way music moves people.
ex.zh: 音樂打動人心的方式有一種神奇的魔力。

algiers.zh: 阿爾及爾（阿爾及利亞首都）

ex.en: Algiers is the capital of Algeria.
ex.zh: 阿爾及爾是阿爾及利亞的首都。

ex.en: Algiers sits on the Mediterranean coast.
ex.zh: 阿爾及爾位於地中海沿岸。

ex.en: She is an alum of the university and often visits the campus.
ex.zh: 她是這所大學的校友，常回校園看看。

ex.en: Alums were invited to the school's anniversary dinner.
ex.zh: 校友們受邀參加學校的週年晚宴。

ex.en: Alum is sometimes used to clean water.
ex.zh: 明礬有時被用來淨化水。

ex.en: Pickles can stay crisp if a little alum is added.
ex.zh: 醃黃瓜加一點明礬可以保持脆度。

ex.en: She sings alto in the school choir.
ex.zh: 她在學校合唱團唱女低音。

ex.en: The alto sang the lower harmony beautifully.
ex.zh: 女低音優美地唱出低音和聲。

ex.en: We need one more alto for the concert.
ex.zh: 我們的音樂會還缺一位女低音。

ex.en: The doctor checked the albumin level in his blood.
ex.zh: 醫生檢查了他血液中的白蛋白含量。

ex.en: Egg white is rich in albumin.
ex.zh: 蛋白富含白蛋白。

ex.en: Drivers need to keep their alertness on long trips.
ex.zh: 駕駛在長途旅程中必須保持警覺。

ex.en: Coffee can improve alertness in the morning.
ex.zh: 咖啡能讓人早上更清醒機敏。

ex.en: A brief altercation broke out between the two drivers.
ex.zh: 兩位駕駛之間爆發了短暫的爭吵。

ex.en: The altercation ended when the manager arrived.
ex.zh: 經理一到，爭吵就結束了。

aladdin.zh: 阿拉丁（《一千零一夜》故事人物）

ex.en: Aladdin is a character in a tale from The Arabian Nights.
ex.zh: 阿拉丁是《一千零一夜》故事中的人物。

ex.en: In the story, Aladdin finds a magic lamp.
ex.zh: 故事裡，阿拉丁發現了一盞神燈。

ex.en: The writer used an alias to protect her privacy.
ex.zh: 作家用化名來保護自己的隱私。

ex.en: The suspect was known by several aliases.
ex.zh: 這名嫌犯有好幾個別名。

ex.en: Each speaker had the allotted five minutes.
ex.zh: 每位講者都有規定的五分鐘。

ex.en: He finished the test within the allotted time.
ex.zh: 他在規定的時間內完成了測驗。

alarmist.zh: 杞人憂天的人；危言聳聽者

ex.en: Don't be such an alarmist; it's only a small cold.
ex.zh: 別那麼杞人憂天，只是小感冒而已。

ex.en: The scientist was called an alarmist, but his warning turned out to be right.
ex.zh: 那位科學家被說成危言聳聽，但他的警告後來證明是對的。

ex.en: She accepted the invitation with alacrity.
ex.zh: 她欣然接受了邀請。

ex.en: The staff moved with alacrity to fix the problem.
ex.zh: 員工迅速動手解決問題。

ex.en: The farmer checked the almanac for the best planting dates.
ex.zh: 農夫翻閱曆書，找最適合播種的日子。

ex.en: The almanac lists the times of sunrise and sunset.
ex.zh: 這本年鑑列出了日出和日落的時間。

ex.en: An algal bloom turned the lake green.
ex.zh: 藻華讓湖水變成了綠色。

ex.en: Scientists measured the algal growth in the pond.
ex.zh: 科學家測量池塘裡藻類的生長情況。

ex.en: He pays alimony to his former wife every month.
ex.zh: 他每個月付贍養費給前妻。

ex.en: The court set the amount of alimony after the divorce.
ex.zh: 法院在離婚後決定了贍養費的金額。

ex.en: She keeps an aloe plant on the kitchen windowsill.
ex.zh: 她在廚房窗台上養了一盆蘆薈。

ex.en: I rubbed some aloe on my sunburned arm.
ex.zh: 我在曬傷的手臂上抹了一些蘆薈。

ex.en: The lotion contains aloe, which helps soothe dry skin.
ex.zh: 這款乳液含有蘆薈，有助於舒緩乾燥的肌膚。

ex.en: An albatross can glide over the ocean for hours.
ex.zh: 信天翁可以在海面上滑翔好幾個小時。

ex.en: We saw an albatross following the ship.
ex.zh: 我們看到一隻信天翁跟著那艘船。

ex.en: The old debt became an albatross around the company's neck.
ex.zh: 那筆舊債成了公司沉重的負擔。

ex.en: His past mistake was an albatross that followed him for years.
ex.zh: 他過去的錯誤成了多年來揮之不去的包袱。

ex.en: There are a lot of people waiting outside the store.
ex.zh: 店外有很多人在排隊。

ex.en: He drinks a lot of water during a workout.
ex.zh: 他運動時會喝很多水。

ex.en: We had a lot of fun at the night market yesterday.
ex.zh: 我們昨天在夜市玩得很開心。
